description: The famous passphrase 'correct horse battery staple 2026' is accepted without any warning, while the dialog claims the check catches obvious patterns.
expected: Known phrases flagged or the copy softened.
suggested_fix: Add a small known-phrase list or reword the hint.

description: Mismatched confirmation is reported before a weak-passphrase message, so the user can fix the mismatch and then hit a second error.
expected: Show all problems at once or check strength first.
actual: Only 'The passphrases don't match.' shown for mismatched weak input.

description: Passphrase inputs render as solid black boxes with no placeholder (look like decorative bars when empty); the disabled Create button is paler than the adjacent secondary button.
expected: Visible input affordance and an evident primary.
suggested_fix: White input with border, placeholder, clearer disabled style.

description: The setup dialog never says what the passphrase does or that the agent needs the fingerprint afterwards; the success notice says only 'Your agent can now add its drives'.
expected: One line: what unlocks, and that the agent must run account seal with the fingerprint.
suggested_fix: Add the explanation and a 'Next: pin the fingerprint on your agent' hint.
